checks.detail: Deterministic templates cover EMA, SMA, RSI, and Bollinger strategies.

results.prompt: Buy BTC/IDR on 1h when the 20 EMA crosses above the 50 EMA, exit when it crosses below.
assumptions: Used EMA periods 20 and 50 from the description.
Assumed 90% of equity per position, a 5% stop loss, and no take profit.
warnings: Crossover strategies can whipsaw in sideways markets.

results.prompt: Use an EMA crossover on Ethereum to follow the trend.
assumptions: Assumed EMA periods 20 and 50 because the description did not specify both.
Assumed 90% of equity per position, a 5% stop loss, and no take profit.
warnings: Crossover strategies can whipsaw in sideways markets.

results.prompt: On ETHIDR 4h, enter long when EMA 12 crosses above EMA 26 and exit on the reverse cross.
assumptions: Used EMA periods 4 and 12 from the description.
Assumed 90% of equity per position, a 5% stop loss, and no take profit.
warnings: Crossover strategies can whipsaw in sideways markets.

results.prompt: Buy bitcoin when RSI 14 crosses above 30 and sell when RSI is above 70.
assumptions: Used RSI period 14.
Assumed entry at RSI 30 and exit at RSI 70.
Assumed 90% of equity per position with a 6% stop loss and 12% take profit.
warnings: Mean reversion can fail during sustained downtrends.

results.prompt: Make a mean reversion strategy with RSI for ETH.
assumptions: Used RSI period 14.
Assumed entry at RSI 30 and exit at RSI 70.
Assumed 90% of equity per position with a 6% stop loss and 12% take profit.
warnings: Mean reversion can fail during sustained downtrends.

results.prompt: Buy when price closes back above the lower Bollinger band (20, 2 standard deviations) and exit at the upper band.
assumptions: Used Bollinger period 20 and 2 standard deviations.
Assumed entry when close crosses back above the lower band and exit when close crosses above the upper band.
Assumed 90% of equity, a 7% stop loss, and a 14% take profit.
warnings: Band touches are not the same as closes; this rule waits for a close.

results.prompt: Simple moving average crossover: 10 and 30 on BTC 1h, long only.
assumptions: Used SMA periods 10 and 30.
Assumed 90% of equity, a 5% stop loss, and no take profit.
warnings: Simple moving averages react more slowly than EMAs.

results.prompt: Enter BTC long when EMA 20 is above EMA 50 and RSI 14 is below 60; exit when EMA 20 falls below EMA 50.
assumptions: Used RSI period 20.
Assumed entry at RSI 14 and exit at RSI 50.
Assumed 90% of equity per position with a 6% stop loss and 12% take profit.
warnings: Mean reversion can fail during sustained downtrends.

results.prompt: Buy when it goes up and sell when it goes down.
